description: In bronco_ocr.dll (C++), load data/skilldata/pt-br/skills_tooltips.json at init and, when an OCR line matches a skill NAME, return the FULL structured translated tooltip as ready-to-render display lines. Add a config key 'skilldata_path' (default 'data/skilldata'). Format each fact line in C++ from the fact kind + stored translated label + stored value (e.g. 'Dano', 'Duração: 10 segundos', 'Número de Alvos: 5', 'Recarga: 25', 'Raio: 240'). Keep the existing name-translation behavior working (additive). Raise BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS so a full multi-line tooltip fits, keeping the loader allocation in sync. CANNOT be compiled in this Linux sandbox; be meticulous about C++ correctness (variable scope, exact types, matching .h declarations, nlohmann::json usage, balanced braces).
steps: Add a new SkillTooltip store. Create src/translation/skill_tooltips.h and src/translation/skill_tooltips.cpp in namespace bronco::translation. Define a struct SkillFactLine { std::string text; } is NOT enough - instead define struct SkillTooltip { std::string nameTranslated; std::string typeTranslated; std::string descriptionTranslated; std::vector<std::string> notes; std::vector<std::string> factLines; }; where factLines are FULLY FORMATTED PT-BR strings ready to render. Define class SkillTooltipStore with: bool loadFromFile(const std::filesystem::path& file); std::optional<SkillTooltip> lookup(const std::string& skillNameEn) const; std::size_t size() const; Use the SAME normalization as Dictionary::normalize (lowercase + collapse whitespace + trim) for the lookup key on name_en - to avoid divergence, expose a public static Dictionary::normalize (change it from private static to public static in dictionary.h, or add a free helper in a shared header) and reuse it here. Document the choice in a comment.

Implement SkillTooltipStore::loadFromFile using nlohmann::json (already a bronco_ocr.dll dependency). Parse {skills:[...]}. For each skill: key = normalize(name_en). Build a SkillTooltip: nameTranslated = 'name' (fallback name_en); typeTranslated = 'type'; descriptionTranslated = 'description'. Build notes from translated flags/categories if present (each a short line, e.g. a flag 'NoUnderwater' translated in the JSON or mapped to a readable PT-BR note; if only English is present, still show it - do NOT crash). Build factLines by formatting each fact via a helper formatFact(const nlohmann::json& fact) -> std::optional<std::string>. Store into an unordered_map<std::string, SkillTooltip>. Be defensive: use value(key, default) accessors, check is_string/is_number before get, wrap in try/catch returning false on parse failure (mirror Dictionary::loadFromFile).

Implement formatFact(fact) in skill_tooltips.cpp. Read fact['type'] (string, may be unknown/empty) and the translated label fact['label'] (fallback fact['label_en'] then empty). Compose a line based on kind: Damage -> label + optional ' x' + hit_count when >1 (e.g. 'Dano (x6)'); Duration/Time -> label + ': ' + duration + ' ' + (duration==1?'segundo':'segundos'); Recharge -> label + ': ' + value (+ ' s'); Range/Number/Distance/Radius -> label + ': ' + (value or distance); Percent -> label + ': ' + percent + '%'; StunBreak/Unblockable/NoData -> just the label; Buff/PrefixedBuff -> use translated 'status' (fallback label) + optional ' (' + apply_count + ')' when apply_count>1 + optional ': ' + duration + 's' when duration present + optional ' - ' + translated 'description' when present; ComboField -> label + ': ' + field_type; ComboFinisher -> label + ': ' + finisher_type (+ percent% if present); AttributeAdjust -> label + ': ' + value (+ target if present). For UNKNOWN/unlisted kinds (e.g. 'BuffArray' or empty type): emit the translated label plus any single present numeric value (value/duration/percent/distance) so nothing is lost and nothing crashes. Return std::nullopt only when the resulting line would be empty. Keep all number-to-string via std::to_string; guard optional numeric fields with fact.contains(...) && fact[...].is_number().

Add the SkillTooltipStore to the translation layer so bronco_ocr.dll can use it. In src/translation/translator.h add a member SkillTooltipStore m_skillTooltips; add `bool initialize(..., const std::string& skillDataPath, const std::string& locale, ...)` OR add a separate `bool loadSkillTooltips(const std::string& skillDataPath, const std::string& locale)` method plus `const SkillTooltipStore& skillTooltips() const`. Prefer a separate loadSkillTooltips() to keep the initialize() signature minimal, and call it from ocr_api's initialize. Include skill_tooltips.h in translator.h. Add skill_tooltips.cpp to src/ocr/CMakeLists.txt BRONCO_OCR_SOURCES (alongside translation/translator.cpp and translation/dictionary.cpp).

Change the C API to carry a full tooltip. In src/ocr/ocr_api.h: raise `#define BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS 96` (comment why: a full skill tooltip has many fact lines). Add a new export `bronco_ocr_initialize2` OR extend bronco_ocr_initialize with a trailing `const char* skillDataPath` parameter. To avoid breaking the loader's function-pointer typedef, EXTEND the existing bronco_ocr_initialize signature by ADDING a `const char* skillDataPath` parameter AFTER locale and BEFORE confidenceThreshold, and update BOTH ocr_api.h, ocr_api.cpp, ocr_loader.h (PFN_Initialize typedef + m_fnInitialize call + OcrLoader::initialize signature) and its caller in pipeline.cpp so every layer passes skilldata path. Keep BroncoOcrResult struct unchanged; the full tooltip is emitted as MULTIPLE consecutive BroncoOcrResult lines, all marked matched=1, sharing the matched skill's region geometry.

In ocr_api.cpp bronco_ocr_initialize: after translator.initialize(...) succeeds, call handle->translator.loadSkillTooltips(skillDataPath, locale) (log but do NOT fail init if the skilldata file is missing - the name-only path must keep working). In bronco_ocr_process_frame: after computing `translation` for a line, when it matched AND the matched original corresponds to a skill name, look up the full tooltip via handle->translator.skillTooltips().lookup(<the matched skill english name>). NOTE the current translate() returns the dictionary value (already PT-BR) and the matched English key is not directly returned; to get the English skill name for the skilldata key, look up the tooltip by the ORIGINAL OCR line's best skill-name match. Simplest correct approach: SkillTooltipStore::lookup should accept the raw/normalized OCR line and internally do exact-then-contains matching on name_en (reuse the same word-boundary 'substantial key' rule as Dictionary::lookupContains so behavior matches the existing name matcher). Implement lookupContains-style matching inside SkillTooltipStore so a matched line yields its tooltip directly from the OCR line, independent of the dictionary value.

When a tooltip is found for a line, emit its lines in order into outResults (respecting BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS and the reserve-before-loop rule): first a header line = nameTranslated; then a line = typeTranslated (if non-empty); then the descriptionTranslated (if non-empty); then each note; then each factLine. Every emitted line uses matched=1 and the region geometry of the current OCR result. CRITICAL marshalling: continue to push each display string into handle->resultStorage (already reserved to BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS before the loop) and point outResults[count].originalText/translatedText at resultStorage.back() c_str(); increment count with the cap check on EVERY emitted line. If NO tooltip is found, fall back to the existing single-line behavior (matched name translation, or raw line). Re-read the whole function end to end to confirm no resultStorage reallocation and no count overflow.

Add the config key. In src/config/config.h: add std::string m_skillDataPath = "data/skilldata"; and a getter std::string skillDataPath() const; (shared_lock like the others). In src/config/config.cpp: read json 'skilldata_path' in loadInternal (with default), WRITE it in save() (json["skilldata_path"] = m_skillDataPath;), and implement the getter. In config/bronco_config.json: add "skilldata_path": "data/skilldata" near dictionary_path.

In src/pipeline/pipeline.cpp initializeModules(): pass config.skillDataPath() into g_ocrLoader.initialize(...) at the new parameter position (matching the extended signature). Keep the rest of the pipeline (follow-mouse OCR, logging, setTranslations) unchanged. Ensure the extra parameter is threaded through consistently so there is no argument-count mismatch (this is a common compile error - verify the call site matches the new OcrLoader::initialize signature exactly).
acceptance_criteria: New files src/translation/skill_tooltips.h and .cpp exist in namespace bronco::translation; every method used elsewhere is declared in the .h; skill_tooltips.cpp is added to src/ocr/CMakeLists.txt BRONCO_OCR_SOURCES.

BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS raised to 96 in ocr_api.h; ocr_loader.cpp allocates that many slots via the macro (no separate hard-coded number); ocr_api.cpp caps emitted count at the macro and reserves resultStorage to the macro before the emit loop.

bronco_ocr_initialize signature is extended with a skillDataPath parameter consistently across ocr_api.h, ocr_api.cpp, ocr_loader.h (PFN_Initialize + OcrLoader::initialize) and the pipeline.cpp call site - no argument-count mismatch.

On a matched skill name, process_frame emits the full tooltip as multiple matched=1 lines (name header, type, description, notes, formatted fact lines) using the matched line's region geometry; when no tooltip is found, the previous single-line behavior is unchanged.
formatFact handles all listed fact kinds AND unknown/unlisted kinds (e.g. 'BuffArray', empty) without crashing, using fact.contains(...) + is_number/is_string guards and std::to_string for numbers.
Config key 'skilldata_path' is present in config.h (member+getter), read in loadInternal, written in save(), and added to config/bronco_config.json with default 'data/skilldata'.
Missing skilldata file does not fail engine init; the name-only translation path still works.
Static review confirms: no block-scoped variable used outside its block, balanced braces, no undeclared identifiers, exact types, nlohmann::json used defensively.
verification: Static C++ review only (no compiler in sandbox): re-read each edited/new function end-to-end; confirm every new method has a matching .h declaration; confirm ocr_api.h macro, ocr_loader.cpp allocation, and ocr_api.cpp reserve/cap all reference BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS; confirm the extended bronco_ocr_initialize signature matches across ocr_api.h/.cpp, ocr_loader.h/.cpp, and pipeline.cpp; confirm config key present in config.h + config.cpp load AND save + config/bronco_config.json.
Grep to confirm no lingering hard-coded 64 for the result cap and that skilldata_path appears in all required files.
Verify skill_tooltips.cpp is listed in src/ocr/CMakeLists.txt.
findings: Implemented the C++ side of full tooltip reconstruction. New files src/translation/skill_tooltips.{h,cpp} (namespace bronco::translation): struct SkillTooltip {nameTranslated,typeTranslated,descriptionTranslated,notes[],factLines[]} and class SkillTooltipStore {loadFromFile, lookup, size}. Made Dictionary::normalize AND Dictionary::containsOnWordBoundary public static (previously private) so SkillTooltipStore reuses the EXACT same normalization + word-boundary contains rule as the name matcher (documented in dictionary.h comments). SkillTooltipStore::lookup does exact-normalized then word-boundary-contains match on name_en (same substantial-key rule: multi-word>=6 or single-word>=8, longest key wins). loadFromFile parses {skills:[...]} defensively (jsonStr/hasNumber helpers, try/catch->false, mirrors Dictionary::loadFromFile). formatFact() handles every real fact.type observed (Damage,Heal,Duration,Time,Recharge,Range,Number,Distance,Radius,Percent,StunBreak,Unblockable,NoData,Buff,PrefixedBuff,ComboField,ComboFinisher,AttributeAdjust) PLUS unknown/empty types (fallback: label + any single present numeric value); returns nullopt only when the line would be empty; all numbers via std::to_string / numToStr (collapses integral doubles, trims trailing zeros). Buff/PrefixedBuff use translated 'status' (fallback label) + apply_count(>1) + duration + description + nested prefix status. Skill-type values (Profession/Elite/Heal/etc) are the top-level 'type'; fact kinds are fact-level 'type' - handled separately. Translator gained loadSkillTooltips(skillDataPath, locale) [loads <skillDataPath>/<locale>/skills_tooltips.json] and skillTooltips() accessor + member m_skillTooltips; translator.h includes skill_tooltips.h; translator.cpp includes <filesystem>. C API: BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS raised 64->96 (comment updated); bronco_ocr_initialize extended with `const char* skillDataPath` AFTER locale, BEFORE confidenceThreshold, threaded consistently through ocr_api.h/.cpp, ocr_loader.h (PFN_Initialize typedef + OcrLoader::initialize signature), ocr_loader.cpp (call site), and pipeline.cpp (passes config.skillDataPath()). ocr_api.cpp initialize calls loadSkillTooltips after translator.initialize but does NOT fail init on missing skilldata (logs only; name-only path preserved; guards null skillDataPath). process_frame: resultStorage still cleared+reserved to BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS before the loop; new emitLine lambda [captures &] does the cap check (count>=BRONCO_OCR_MAX_RESULTS -> return false) on EVERY emitted line, pushes into resultStorage, points originalText/translatedText at resultStorage.back().c_str(), copies current ocr region geometry + confidence, matched flag, ++count. On a matched skill line: emits nameTranslated header, type (if non-empty), description (if non-empty), each note, each factLine, all matched=1 sharing the OCR region geometry. Fallback when no tooltip: matched name translation (matched=1) or raw line (matched=0) - previous behavior preserved. skill_tooltips.cpp added to src/ocr/CMakeLists.txt BRONCO_OCR_SOURCES. Config: skilldata_path key added to config.h (member m_skillDataPath default 'data/skilldata' + getter), config.cpp (read in loadInternal, written in save(), getter impl), and config/bronco_config.json (near dictionary_path). CANNOT compile in this Linux sandbox (Windows/MSVC/vcpkg only); verification was static review + grep: brace balance confirmed (matched open/close counts in every edited .cpp/.h), JSON validity confirmed for config + skilldata, no lingering hard-coded 64 result cap, skilldata_path/skillDataPath present in all required layers, extended signature consistent across ocr_api.h/.cpp+ocr_loader.h/.cpp+pipeline.cpp, skill_tooltips.cpp listed in CMakeLists. No block-scoped variable used outside its block (count is function-scoped; ocr is used only within its loop iteration; emitLine captures by reference). Overlay rendering intentionally NOT done here (that is FEAT-003).
